correctness.rationale: Stable 1-WL compares the starting uniform color and neighbor-color multiset at each synchronous round. Independent enumerator used the complete seven-vertex unlabeled graph atlas, chordal and asteroidal-triple-free interval test, and eight-vertex clique-neighborhood extensions, with exact graph-isomorphism deduplication. Counts of connected interval classes n1..8 were independently reproduced as 1,1,2,5,15,56,250,1328, with no orbit-vs-color mismatch through 7 and exactly one n8 mismatch. The graph6 witness GIc`KO is two K3 triangles joined at attachment vertices by a path of exactly three edges: n8, m9. Its degree partition already is stable with 2 vertices of degree3 and six degree2, equitable quotient [[0,3],[1,1]], yet true automorphism-orbits have sizes 2,2,4 (attachment vertices, internal path vertices, four triangle twins); nonisomorphism among the latter cells is secured by triangle membership. All n8 interval graphs descend from clique-neighborhood extension of a connected seven-vertex interval graph because a terminal interval clique end vertex is simplicial. The independent search checked automorphisms exactly, not only matching histogram.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: In the refinable-graph literature, orbit-refinability means the stable equitable partition is precisely the Aut(G)-orbit partition; it is not graph identification up to C2 among different graphs. An already-known example under this alias does not imply uniqueness in the entire connected interval class at n<=8.
